prompt_text: Best nonprofit CRM with email and text messaging
response_text:
For a **nonprofit CRM with both email and text messaging**, the strongest all-in-one options in your results are **Virtuous**, **Giveffect**, and **DonorPerfect**. If you want the simplest “best overall” pick from these sources, **Virtuous** is positioned as the best email platform because its email tools are *integrated into the CRM*[2], while **Giveffect** explicitly offers nonprofit **email marketing, text messaging, and performance tracking** in one system[1].

A practical way to choose:

| Platform | Best for | Email | Text messaging | Notes |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| **Virtuous** | Nonprofits wanting CRM-native engagement tools | Yes | Not highlighted in the result | The source says its email marketing is best because it is integrated into the CRM[2]. |
| **Giveffect** | All-in-one nonprofit communications | Yes | Yes | Promotes email marketing, text messaging, and analytics together[1]. |
| **DonorPerfect** | Nonprofits that want fundraising plus SMS via partner integration | Yes | Yes, via Constant Contact partnership | The result says Constant Contact partners with DonorPerfect for a seamless email and text fundraising platform[3]. |
| **Insightly** | Mid-sized nonprofits with program delivery needs | Likely yes, as a CRM option | Not emphasized in the result | The result lists it as a top nonprofit CRM, but does not focus on messaging features[4]. |

If your priority is **one platform that clearly includes both email and text messaging**, **Giveffect** is the cleanest match from the search results[1]. If you care most about **CRM-native email engagement**, **Virtuous** is the strongest email-focused recommendation[2]. If you want **donor CRM plus SMS through an integration**, **DonorPerfect** is a good fit[3].

If you want, I can narrow this down to the **best choice for small nonprofits, mid-sized nonprofits, or fundraising-first teams**.
